answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 146931 Country: India Title: LIC-Policy Question: I am a free-lancer based in Delhi. I live in a rented house. My annual income is 8-10 lakhs rupees. My questions are: (1) I have an LIC Policy where I have to pay 24000/- per year. It covers death as well. Is it allowed? (2) Can I take Home-Loan from a bank on interest? I have no other source of income, though I have some farming land. Answer ID: 146931 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 291/267/B=3/1438) (1) The business of LIC is based on interest and gambling; hence it is not lawful for a Muslim to avail such policy. (2) It is not lawful for a Muslim to take loan from a bank in normal condition. It puts a man in trial and invites misfortune and problems in the house and business. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
